title: 4096-bit (4K x 1) dynamic RAM, 16-pin, multiplexed address

sources.document: Mostek 1978 Memory Data Book and Designers Guide, MK4096(K/N)-6/16/11 4096x1-bit dynamic RAM

pins.name: RAS
pins.text: row address strobe: latches A0..A5 as row address

pins.name: CAS
pins.text: column address strobe: latches A0..A5 as column address, CS and DIN

functions.text: Three-state TTL output, latched and valid into the next cycle. Data valid tRAC after RAS falls and tCAC after CAS falls; turns off tOFF after CAS goes high. Output swings VSS..VCC (VCC feeds only the output buffer).

state.read: Row address on A0..A5 latched by RAS falling, column address latched by CAS falling (12 address bits on 6 pins). WRITE high (read command set up before CAS).
state.write: WRITE low; data latched at CAS falling (random write) or at WRITE falling (delayed write / read-modify-write).
state.refresh: Every 2 ms; RAS-only cycles are supported (IDD3). After power-up at least one cycle with both RAS and CAS before normal use.

electrical.notes: VDD 11.4..12.6 V, VCC = VSS..VDD (5 V +-10% in the AC tables), VBB -4.5..-5.5 V, VSS 0. VIHC (RAS, CAS, WRITE) 2.7 V min (3.0 V for -11), VIH 2.4 V, VIL 0.8 V. VOL 0.4 V at 2 mA, VOH 2.4 V at -5 mA.

Read-modify-write and page-mode timing pages were not read.
notes: Two methods of chip select are mentioned in the description; only CS latched by CAS was read.

stored.source: pdf 97-103 (printed 91-97) - Mostek 1978 Memory Data Book, MK4096, DATA INPUT/OUTPUT and DATA OUTPUT LATCH (printed 96-97): at every falling CAS the output goes open; it drives again only if RAS is active and the chip is selected, and stays valid until the next falling CAS. RAS-only cycles do not change it.

stored.name: OD
stored.source: pdf 97-103 (printed 91-97) - Mostek 1978 Memory Data Book, MK4096, DATA INPUT/OUTPUT and DATA OUTPUT LATCH (printed 96-97): the output latch takes the data read while CAS is low (read part of the cycle, WRITE high); same polarity as the input; a write cycle gives a logic 1. It holds when WRITE falls (read-modify-write) and after CAS rises.

write.when: NOT WRITE AND NOT CAS AND NOT RAS AND NOT LCS

memory.source: pdf 97-103 (printed 91-97) - Mostek 1978 Memory Data Book, MK4096, DATA INPUT/OUTPUT and DATA OUTPUT LATCH (printed 96-97): data in is latched by the later of WRITE and CAS to fall while RAS is active; not written when CS was high at CAS time. The order of row and column bits inside the 12-bit address is not stated (it does not change the logic). Refresh (the cells forget unless each row is cycled every 2 ms) is not part of the logic model.
